name: Focus Master
text: Do two uninterrupted study sessions today

name: Mindful Mover
text: Stretch after finishing a focus session

name: Task Slayer
text: Clear one item from your in progress list

name: Goal Setter
text: Write one measurable goal for this week

name: Space Organizer
text: Take 3 minutes to organize your study space

name: Habit Builder
text: Identify one habit you'd like to build

name: Prep Pro
text: Write down your top 3 priorities for today's study session

name: Distraction Dodger
text: Keep your phone in another room while studying

name: Brain Break
text: Step away from your screen and take a 5 minute break outside
